description: Canonical open registry for application content and policy capability identifiers advertised by Arkret MLS KeyPackages and selected as an MLS group capability floor.

registry_rules.unknown_values: preserve but treat as unsupported; an unknown value never satisfies claim admission, a group floor, or sender authorization
registry_rules.claim_rule: required_capabilities MUST contain active registered values and be a subset of both the signed LeafNode keypackage_capabilities extension and the outer claim record capabilities
registry_rules.group_rule: required_keypackage_capabilities GroupContext values MUST be active registered rows and every current or added LeafNode keypackage_capabilities value set MUST be a superset
registry_rules.sender_rule: an application capability may be used in an MLS application message only when it is present in the current required_keypackage_capabilities GroupContext extension

capabilities.description: Arkret v1 Content Block and encrypted application-content semantics.
MIMI Content interoperability profile selected by an Arkret group that carries MIMI application content.
